skills.name: analyze-sales-call
skills.description: Analyze B2B sales transcripts or notes. Use for call recaps, evidence extraction, next steps, or feedback on a specific conversation.

skills.default_prompt: Use $analyze-sales-call to turn this sales call into evidence, decisions, and coaching.

skills.description: Analyze B2B buying decisions. Use for win/loss reviews, no-decision analysis, or comparisons across closed opportunities.
